reason: A DeepSeek Harness terminal presentation plugin focused on compact conversational layout, response rendering, status display, and optional tool-detail inspection; the README also documents a current-user Windows context-menu installer.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供简洁的终端对话界面，用于输入消息、查看模型回答、显示运行状态并按需检查工具调用详情。
summaries.en: A compact terminal interface for DeepSeek Harness that accepts messages, renders model answers and activity status, and optionally shows retained tool-call details.

capabilities: Provides a terminal user interface for entering messages and viewing model answers
Renders streaming responses, activity states, failures, and optionally retained tool details
Supports terminal commands for cancellation, verbosity, tool inspection, and session exit
Provides a Windows current-user context-menu installer that launches DSH in the selected directory
